Container.Name: Tinkerex
Container.Overview: A self-hosted library for a maker's files (3D models, CAD, laser, PDFs, images) with thumbnails, projects, inventory and a Tools gallery. Point it at a share that holds your files; it indexes them every 15 minutes and on demand, uploads land in the share as plain files, and the first account you create becomes the owner. It runs as the share's owner, so uploads land on the share owned the way your other files are. Full reference: docs/INSTALL.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port the web app is reached on.

Config.Name: App data (database and thumbnails)
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite databases, the thumbnails and the session secret. Created on first start; nothing to prepare.

Config.Name: Library (your files)
Config.Description: The share that holds your files. Indexed every 15 minutes and on the Rescan button; uploads and deletions happen inside it (deleted files move to its .trash folder). The app runs as this share's owner unless PUID/PGID say otherwise, so it can write here on a stock share.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Leave empty to run as the share's owner (99, nobody, on a stock Unraid share). Set it to run as someone else.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Leave empty to run as the share's group (100, users, on a stock Unraid share). Set it with PUID to run as someone else.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
Config.Description: Optional. Generated on the first start and kept in the app data folder; set it only to use your own (openssl rand -hex 64).

Config.Name: APP_HOST
Config.Description: Only needed with SMTP_ADDRESS: the host name or IP people reach this server at, with no scheme (e.g. 192.168.1.20). Links in email point at it.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_BACKEND
Config.Description: Fixed for this template: the library is the share mounted at /library.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_PATH
Config.Description: Fixed for this template: where the library share is mounted inside the container.

Config.Name: RAILS_MAX_THREADS
Config.Description: Web server threads and the database pool.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Leave empty (closed): the first account you create is the owner and sign-ups close after it. 'open' is refused on this backend, because every account would see the same share; add accounts from the console instead (docs/INSTALL.md section 4).

Config.Name: SMTP_ADDRESS
Config.Description: SMTP host for confirmation and password-reset mail. Empty means no mail, which the first account does not need. Setting it requires APP_HOST too.

Config.Name: SMTP_USER_NAME
Config.Description: SMTP user, if the relay needs authentication.

Config.Name: MAIL_FROM
Config.Description: Sender address for mail; defaults to no-reply at APP_HOST.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_TRASH_DAYS
Config.Description: Days a deleted file stays in the share's .trash folder before the daily purge; 0 keeps everything forever.
